lines.title: Phase 0 gear lists ranked again, with newer gold prices
lines.note: Every DPS spec's Phase 0 list was ranked again on the current sim, with prices from a newer auction house scan, and each preset wears its list's picks. Heart of Wyrmthalak tops the trinket list of 12 specs but costs too much gold per DPS on all of them, so no preset wears it. Fire, Frost, Frostfire, Demonology, Shadow, Smite, Beast Mastery, Marksmanship, Survival, Arms and Fury 2H keep their gear.

lines.title: Balance wears Talisman of Ascendance and Spirit of Aquementas
lines.note: Talisman of Ascendance replaces Chained Essence, and Spirit of Aquementas replaces Obsidian Bauble, which costs too much gold per DPS. Balance gains 5.6 DPS at 180s.

lines.title: Feral throws Goblin Land Mine instead of Dark Bomb
lines.note: Dark Bomb does nothing to level 63 bosses, so the rotation uses Goblin Land Mine in its place. Feral gains 0.5 DPS.

lines.title: Lone Wolf takes Hawkeye Bow of Agility
lines.note: Eaglehorn Long Bow costs too much gold per DPS, so Lone Wolf wears Hawkeye Bow of Agility and loses 4.6 DPS at 180s.

lines.title: Arcane enchants its staff with Revelation
lines.note: Revelation replaces Spellblasting on Arcane's staff, for 3.9 more DPS.

lines.title: Retribution wields Destiny
lines.note: Destiny replaces Warblade of Caer Darrow for Twist and Sub Holy Retribution, about 9.5 more DPS at 180s. Shock Retribution keeps Warblade, which still suits it best.

lines.title: Dagger rogues wear the Devilsaur pair, Seal Fate Swords takes Ancient Bone Bow
lines.note: Combat Daggers, Mutilate, Subtlety and Seal Fate Daggers wear Devilsaur Gauntlets and Leggings in place of the Darkmantle pieces, since the two piece Devilsaur bonus beats the six piece Darkmantle one. Each gains 0.7 to 1.7 DPS. Deep Jungle Rifle costs too much gold per DPS, so Seal Fate Swords wears Ancient Bone Bow and loses 9.2 DPS.

lines.title: Shamans change trinkets, Improved Ghost Wolf talents fixed
lines.note: Elemental wears Talisman of Ascendance in place of Eye of the Beast, for 3.5 more DPS. Enhancement wears Blackhand's Breadth in place of Adaptive Combat Assistant and loses about 1.3 DPS. The Improved Ghost Wolf preset now has talents the game allows, with the same DPS.

lines.title: Warlocks change their enchant and trinket
lines.note: Affliction enchants its main hand with Revelation in place of Mighty Intellect, for 2.9 more DPS, and Shadow Bolt Affliction gains 27.1. Destruction wears Eye of the Beast in place of Weakness Analyzer at the same DPS. Fire Destruction shares that gear and loses 3.4 DPS.

lines.title: Dual-wield Fury takes Thrash Blade and Bloodseeker
lines.note: Thrash Blade replaces Ironwood Blade in the main hand, the trinkets are Darkmoon Card: Maelstrom and Blackhand's Breadth, and Bloodseeker replaces Satyr's Bow, which costs too much gold per DPS. Dual-wield Fury gains 2.1 DPS at 180s.

lines.title: Seal Fate Swords wears Darkmoon Card: Maelstrom
lines.note: Darkmoon Card: Maelstrom replaces Chained Essence of Eranikus beside Blackhand's Breadth, for about 9 more DPS.

lines.title: Tanking presets now wear real Phase 0 gear instead of synthetic gear
lines.note: Protection Warrior, Protection Paladin, Bear and Warden presets now wear gear you can get at level 60 in the first phase of the game, with one list for each of Balanced, Max threat and Max survival. Each faction's races wear their own faction's rewards. Before, they wore synthetic items made for the report.

lines.title: Bear: Lacerate's first hit deals damage, Balanced and Max threat skip Demoralizing Roar
lines.note: Lacerate's hit grows with the stacks the cast leaves, as tested in game, so the first cast hits for 10% of weapon damage. Before, it hit for nothing. Balanced and Max threat no longer use Demoralizing Roar, since its global cooldown and Rage do more on attacks.

lines.title: Warden presets play races a shaman can be
lines.note: Balanced and Max threat are now Troll (was Night Elf), and Max survival is Tauren (was Undead).

lines.title: Healing presets now wear real Phase 0 gear instead of synthetic gear
lines.note: Discipline Priest, Holy Priest, Holy Paladin, Restoration Shaman and Restoration Druid now wear gear you can get at level 60 in the first phase of the game, one list per spec for both tank and raid healing. Each faction's races wear their own faction's rewards. Before, they wore synthetic items made for the report.

lines.title: Tank and healer gear skips items over 3000g for each 1% of score
lines.note: The same gold line as the DPS gear's 30g per DPS, scaled to each preset's own score.

title: Phase 0 gear priced for every spec

lines.title: The 30 gold per DPS line now prices every spec's own gear list
lines.note: Each spec's list is priced on its own: an item's gold per DPS is what it costs over the next cheaper item, divided by the DPS it adds to that spec. Before, only Enhancement's list was priced. A dungeon drop is now priced as if you are the only one who rolls on it (before, you won half of them). Prices come from an auction house scan of November 24, 09:12 UTC, AtlasLoot 1.4.7 drop rates and client 1.60.1.71037.

lines.title: Mages drop Headmaster's Charge, Star of Mystaria, Rune Band of Wizardry and the dungeon wands
lines.note: Their picks went over 30 gold per DPS. Arcane: Staff of Sorrow, Lady Maye's Pendant and Oblivion's Touch, 828.9 to 827.2 at 180s. Fire: Orb of the Darkmoon, Watcher's Signet of Brilliance and Dragon Finger of Fiery Wrath, 912.8 to 911.6. Frost: Channeler's Ring and Dragon Finger of Frozen Wrath, 724.4 to 722.1. Frostfire: Orb of the Darkmoon and Watcher's Signet of Brilliance, 858.8 to 859.6.

lines.title: Elemental drops Hand of Edward the Odd, Obsidian Bauble and Rune Band of Wizardry
lines.note: Their picks went over 30 gold per DPS. Darkspear Insurgent's Spellblade, Spirit of Aquementas and Eye of Orgrimmar take their place, 858.7 to 837.8 at 180s.

lines.title: Retribution drops Destiny, Belt of the Archmage and Pristine Scorpid Leggings
lines.note: Their picks went over 30 gold per DPS. Warblade of Caer Darrow, Vindicator's Belt and Ironfeather Leggings take their place, 956.9 to 931.3 at 180s, and the Undead set the same.

lines.title: Balance drops Hand of Edward the Odd, Belt of the Archmage, Rune Band of Wizardry and Watcher's Signet of Brilliance
lines.note: Their picks went over 30 gold per DPS. Grove Subjugator's Blade, Adventurer's Belt of Magic, Channeler's Ring and Songstone of Ironforge take their place, 822.2 to 796.1 at 180s. Tauren and Skyborne Windshaper wear Eye of Orgrimmar for the Songstone.

lines.title: Feral cat drops Cape of the Black Baron
lines.note: Their picks went over 30 gold per DPS. Howler's Furs takes its place, 1057.2 to 1054.2 at 180s.

lines.title: Shadow drops Hand of Edward the Odd, Obsidian Bauble, Rune Band of Wizardry and its Felcloth Gloves
lines.note: Their picks went over 30 gold per DPS. Blade of the New Moon, Eternal Rod of Shadow Wrath, Eye of Orgrimmar, Eternal Gloves of Shadow Wrath, Virtuous Cowl and Robes of Dark Summons take their place, 857.5 to 849.2 at 180s.

lines.title: Smite drops Hand of Edward the Odd, Maiden's Circle and Ritssyn's Wand of Bad Mojo
lines.note: Their picks went over 30 gold per DPS. Verimonde's Last Resort, Eye of Orgrimmar and Dragon Finger of Magic take their place, 696.5 to 677.5 at 180s.

lines.title: Rogues drop Felstriker, Blackcrow, Deep Jungle Rifle and Cape of the Black Baron
lines.note: Their picks went over 30 gold per DPS. Combat Swords: Greenhammer and Bloodseeker, 844.1 to 842.1 at 180s. Mutilate: Glacial Blade, Distracting Dagger and Bloodseeker, 821.0 to 789.9. Subtlety: Electrified Dagger, Distracting Dagger, Ancient Bone Bow and Howler's Furs, 816.0 to 784.2. Combat Daggers: Glacial Blade and Bloodseeker, 853.7 to 832.7. Seal Fate Swords: Distracting Dagger and Howler's Furs, 864.2 to 853.3. Seal Fate Daggers: Glacial Blade, Bloodseeker and Howler's Furs, 842.3 to 816.6.

lines.title: Hunters drop Cape of the Black Baron, Pendant of Celerity, Bracers of the Eclipse, Felstriker and Iceblade Hacker
lines.note: Their picks went over 30 gold per DPS. Shifting Cloak or Howler's Furs, Mark of Fordring and Beastmaster's Bindings take their place. Beast Mastery and Marksmanship take Hyper Deluxe Sniper Rifle Mk XVII, Lone Wolf Eaglehorn Long Bow, Survival Sword of Zeal, Distracting Dagger and Ancient Bone Bow. At 180s: Beast Mastery 1002.9 to 1039.4, Marksmanship 1082.7 to 1082.8 with the scope, Lone Wolf 1164.8 to 1137.0, Survival 919.5 to 944.4. The others are before the scope below.

lines.title: Warlocks drop Skul's Ghastly Touch, Bonecreeper Stylus, Witchblade, Obsidian Bauble and Rune Band of Wizardry
lines.note: Their picks went over 30 gold per DPS. Affliction: Lunar Wand of Shadow Wrath, 962.1 to 961.3 at 180s. Demonology: Lunar Wand of Shadow Wrath, Eternal Rod and Eternal Crown of Shadow Wrath, Orb of the Darkmoon and Deathmist Wraps, 884.4 to 876.3. Destruction: Grove Subjugator's Blade, Spirit of Aquementas, Lunar Wand of Magic, Channeler's Ring and Eternal Sarong of Magic, 871.7 to 866.6.

lines.title: Warriors drop Ironfoe, Felstriker, Hand of Justice, Truestrike Shoulders and Battleborn Armbraces
lines.note: Their picks went over 30 gold per DPS. Dual-wield Fury: two Ironwood Blades and Valiant's Waistguard, 1014.8 to 984.4 at 180s. Two-hand Fury: Blackhand's Breadth and Hermit's Pauldron, 995.7 to 991.9. Arms: Gargantuan Wristguards, 1017.7 to 1014.7.

lines.title: Hunters can't use thrown weapons
lines.note: Forever's client data limits Auto Shot and every hunter shot to a bow, gun or crossbow, and gives hunters no Thrown skill. Ankle Slicers is out of the hunter lists.

lines.title: Biznicks 247x128 Accurascope is out
lines.note: Its schematic has no source in Forever, so Beast Mastery, Marksmanship and Lone Wolf take Sniper Scope. The Beast Mastery and Marksmanship lists lose 15 and 16.

lines.title: Stun bombs do nothing to level 63 bosses: hunters throw Dense Dynamite, cats Goblin Land Mine
lines.note: Thorium Grenade, EZ-Thro Thorium Grenade and EZ-Thro Dark Bomb miss raid bosses, which can't be stunned. Hunters move from EZ-Thro Dark Bomb to Dense Dynamite and the feral cat to Goblin Land Mine (up 7.7 and 7.9 at 180s). Enhancement and Survival now place Goblin Land Mine too (about 5 each), since a throw keeps the swing timer.

lines.title: New Alliance and Horde gear for one-faction picks
lines.note: Where a pick is one faction's only, the other faction's races wear their own: Alliance lists for Elemental (Songstone of Ironforge and Verimonde's Last Resort), Shadow (Channeler's Ring) and Smite (Songstone of Ironforge), a Horde list for Balance (Eye of Orgrimmar).

lines.title: Arcane Intellect and Divine Spirit overwrite the elixirs of their stat
lines.note: Under Arcane Brilliance an Intellect elixir adds nothing, and under Divine Spirit a Spirit elixir, as the character sheet shows in game. Casters and hunters lose 25 Intellect and up to 25 Spirit.

lines.title: Rage from hits taken follows the stance
lines.note: Defensive Stance gives 0.9 of the Rage from a hit, Berserker 1.1, Battle 1, as our Forever logs show, and a spell, a tick or a special gives twice a melee hit's Rage. Fury up about 6, two-hand Fury about 5, Arms about 3.

lines.title: A hunter's pet crits with its white swings as often as the hunter
lines.note: Since the November 24 hotfix the tamed pet's melee swing takes the crit it inherits from the hunter, as its abilities do. Beast Mastery up 5 to 6%, Marksmanship 2%, Survival 3%, Lone Wolf unchanged.

lines.title: Weapon procs, Ironfoe and dungeon set procs at Forever's measured rates
lines.note: 55 weapons proc at their Forever rate from Warcraft Logs, Ironfoe procs on a flat 3% of hits, dungeon set procs at their measured rates, and Bloodmail and Necropile's 3-piece bonuses proc. Judgement of Command rolls weapon procs twice and Revelation follows its measured rules.

lines.title: Spell resists, overloads, Flurry and Shatter follow Forever's measured rules
lines.note: Bosses resist with Forever's 8 x level + 19, binary spells that land take no partial resist, Blizzard ticks get no Shatter crit, Windfury Weapon hits spend Flurry, Elemental Focus rolls on overloads and Chain Lightning overloads per target, and a Maelstrom Ready! cast keeps Clearcasting.

lines.title: Throws keep the swing timer, demons crit less, extra attacks roll Windfury Totem
lines.note: Explosive throws no longer reset the swing timer. A demon keeps a flat 0.7% melee crit and its own gear instead of the warlock's crit. Extra attacks roll Windfury Totem. Shield Slam procs nothing and Sweeping Strikes' copy takes damage bonuses once.

lines.title: Tanks' threat and Rage from damage follow Forever's measured rules
lines.note: Warrior: Rage-gain threat, Heroic Strike, Cleave, Slam, Shield Slam and Shield Block at their measured values. Bear: Lacerate, Faerie Fire and Enrage as measured. Tanking presets only.

title: Phase 0 gear: what you can get at level 60 today

lines.title: DPS presets now wear real Phase 0 gear instead of synthetic gear
lines.note: Every DPS preset now wears gear you can get at level 60 in the first phase of the game, with each faction's own rewards for its races. Before, they wore synthetic items made for the report. Every DPS preset drops, from 5.6% (Mutilate) to 20.8% (Affliction Shadow Bolt); most lose 7 to 13%. The ranking moves with the gear each spec can get now.

lines.title: Warlocks and dual-wield Fury use their on-use trinkets better
lines.note: Warlocks no longer press Talisman of Ascendance before the pull, which held back their other on-use trinket; it is used on cooldown in the fight. Dual-wield Fury presses Blackhand's Breadth on cooldown instead of saving it for the last 30 seconds.

lines.title: Four assumptions are settled and offer no other settings
lines.note: Four assumptions are settled and no longer offer other settings: the Hyjal and Barrow Deeps flasks give their full bonus, Blood Fury raises weapon damage (as logs show), Execute rolls Windfury Totem twice (as logs show), and Firestone or Spellstone stack with Wizard Oil (Blizzard's warlock preview).

lines.title: Stormstrike deals 100% weapon damage (was 150%) and has an 8 sec cooldown (was 6)
lines.note: No server data carries it yet, so the sim takes the announced values.

lines.title: Mental Dexterity gives 33 / 66 / 100% of Intellect as attack power (was 50 / 100 / 150%)
lines.note: Every Enhancement build takes 3/3, so Intellect is worth a third less to it.

lines.title: Maelstrom Weapon procs 6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10 times a minute by rank, and every stack takes 20% off cast time and mana at every rank
lines.note: A chance per swing by main-hand speed: about 60% a landed hit with a 3.6 speed weapon at 5/5. Before it, every landed melee hit gave a stack, as our combat logs of November 8 and 9 showed, and the sim did that. No server data carries the new rate yet.

lines.title: Weapon imbues and weapon totems work together: Windfury Weapon and Windfury Totem can both proc
lines.note: Before, Windfury Weapon on the main hand turned off the shaman's own benefit from Windfury Totem, and Flametongue Weapon the same for Flametongue Totem. Blizzard doesn't say whether the two Windfury procs share a cooldown, so each keeps its own (an assumption on the Assumptions tab). Every Enhancement build now gets both from its own Windfury Totem.

lines.title: Windfury Totem and Flametongue Totem replace each other: the last one placed takes hold
lines.note: A weapon holds one totem buff, so the Enhancement builds no longer get the raid's Flametongue Totem next to their own Windfury Totem.

lines.title: Stormstrike's mark lands after Stormstrike's own damage
lines.note: So Stormstrike doesn't raise its own damage, which matches our combat logs.

lines.title: Spell damage rolls in whole points, as the game does
lines.note: A fraction of a point at most; only the shaman builds are re-simmed with it so far.

lines.title: Enhancement talents and rotations re-searched
lines.note: Level 60 and Improved Ghost Wolf move Convection to Reverberation, Water Shield moves an Elemental Devastation point to Call of Flame, and the Mana Tide rotation changes. Every build keeps Windfury Weapon with its own Windfury Totem: Flametongue Weapon is 93 to 100 behind at 180 s, Flametongue Totem in Windfury Totem's place 110 to 120. With the hotfixes above, every Enhancement build is down 131 to 142 at 180 s, from first among the shaman builds to below Elemental Level 60 on Mana Tide.

lines.title: Dwarf gear for the new Enhancement builds
lines.note: The Dwarf's extra 1% hit is traded for other stats only where that still gains: on Improved Ghost Wolf (+1.6 at 180 s), no longer on Level 60.

lines.title: Minor Health and Minor Stamina enchants take the Forever client values
lines.note: Minor Health is +2 Stamina (was +5 health) and Minor Stamina +3 Stamina (was +1). No damage moves.

lines.title: Rage of the Storm: 16 Strength, 102 to 154 damage at 3.60 speed
lines.note: A leveling weapon; no level 60 preset wears it.

lines.title: Wrack deals 30% less damage and no longer increases your damage over time effects; while you channel it, Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane of Agony tick twice as fast
lines.note: The damage over time effects keep their total duration, so they tick more often.

lines.title: Soul Siphon counts only Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane of Agony
Affliction keeps Bane of Agony up instead of Bane of Doom, recasts Corruption just before it falls off, and channels Wrack whenever nothing else is due
Imp Firebolt rank 1 deals 6 to 8 damage
lines.note: A leveling rank; no level 60 build changes.

lines.title: Arcane Shot and Summon Hawk cost 11% of base mana at every rank
The hawk from Summon Hawk deals about 80% more melee damage
lines.note: No server data carries it yet, so the sim takes the announced value. The hawk still trails Arcane Shot on the cooldown they share, so no build takes it.

lines.title: Arcane Concentration's chance is shared across the Arcane Missiles cast and its missiles, about 10% a channel in all
lines.note: Before, every missile rolled the full chance. Blizzard's wording allows another reading; the sim takes the split one.

lines.title: Nature's Swiftness also makes Wild Growth instant
lines.note: Healing only; no damage build changes.

lines.title: Idol of Ferocity takes 2 energy off Claw and Rake (was 3)
lines.note: No build wears it.

lines.title: Sweeping Strikes no longer uses a charge on a hit with no second target
lines.note: Only fights with more than one target change.

lines.title: Sparklance Wand deals Arcane damage
lines.note: No build uses it.

lines.title: Earthen Silk Slippers give +17 healing and +6 spell damage (was +18 spell power)
lines.note: No build wears them.

lines.title: Enchant Bracer and Boots - Lesser Spirit give +4 Spirit (was resistance to all schools)
lines.note: No build uses them.

lines.title: Item data refreshed from Wowhead's Forever listing; Blackhand's Breadth gives 1% crit (was 2%)
lines.note: No report build wears the changed items.

lines.title: Sim fix: a damage over time effect no longer ticks once more after it has run out
lines.note: It happened when Wrack's faster ticks or a Deadly Poison refresh moved the last tick past the effect's end. Affliction loses about 6 DPS; rogues move by under 0.5.

lines.title: Windfury Totem procs from white main hand swings and from the main hand attacks that use the weapon, not from every special attack
lines.note: Our combat logs show thousands of totem procs. Heroic Strike, Cleave, Raptor Strike, Sunder Armor, Revenge, Execute and Sinister Strike roll it; Stormstrike (none in 4,467 hits), Holy Strike, Bloodthirst, Whirlwind and Feral attacks never do. Off-hand swings, seal procs and Judgements don't either.

lines.title: Natural flasks give 30 Stamina (was 60), and their zone bonus is 2% (was 4 or 5%)
lines.note: The report's fights take place in the flasks' zones, so the Aggression flask's crit drops from 4% to 2%. Physical builds lose about 15 to 40 DPS.

lines.title: The Chief's Enforcer's Farraki Enforcement proc, at the rate seen in our logs
lines.note: No build wears it.

lines.title: Item data: items seen in game and newly revealed on Forever
lines.note: Hundreds of items added or corrected, among them Edgemaster's Handguards, Shriveled Heart and the Royal Seals of Eldre'Thalas. No report build wears a changed item.

lines.title: Downranked damage spells deal their full damage; the low-rank penalty applies to heals only
lines.note: Our logs show low-rank Lightning Bolt and Fire Nova at their full coefficient. No damage preset downranks.

lines.title: Orc shaman base attributes at levels 2 to 43 from the character sheet
lines.note: Leveling only; level 60 is unchanged.

lines.title: Each class's default build is now its highest at 3 minutes: dual wield Fury, Combat Daggers, Affliction and Lone Wolf
lines.note: They take the place of two-hand Fury, Combat Swords, Destruction and Beast Mastery as the build each class page opens on. No number changes.

lines.title: Two-hand Fury is the warrior's default build again: it is now the highest at 3 minutes
lines.note: Two-hand Fury does 1103.0 against dual wield Fury's 1092.8, so it takes back the build the Warrior page opens on. No number changes.

lines.title: Venom's extra 20% chance to apply poisons now reaches Instant Poison as well as Deadly and Wound Poison
lines.note: The November 3 hotfix's chance row also names Instant Poison's spell group; the sim had left it out. Builds that use Venom (Seal Fate and Mutilate) gain a little.

lines.title: Rake's initial hit now adds 6.5% of attack power
lines.note: A combat log shows Rake's initial hit growing with attack power; the sim had given it none. Feral builds that use Rake gain a little.

lines.title: Hunter pets attack faster with their hunter's melee haste, such as Rapid Fire
lines.note: In combat logs a pet swings 40% faster while its hunter's Rapid Fire is up, and its own Frenzy speeds it up on top of that. The hunter's ranged haste, such as Quick Shots, doesn't reach it. Pets gain about 2 to 10 DPS on Beast Mastery and Marksmanship and about 27 on Survival.

lines.title: Hunter pets use the next ability on their bar when one is short of focus, instead of saving up for it
lines.note: As autocast does in game. Worth about 3 pet DPS.

lines.title: Judgement is a ranged attack: it rolls on the ranged attack table, and melee procs no longer see it
lines.note: From the November 11 hotfixes: Judgement of Command, Righteousness and Fury now roll as ranged attacks, so effects that trigger on melee hits no longer fire from them. Threat is unchanged. Retribution builds lose 0.5 to 0.7%; Protection paladins move too (see the Tanking tab).

lines.title: Survival uses Wing Clip on every free global cooldown, with no mana floor
lines.note: Wing Clip rolls Windfury Totem, so it is worth casting even at low mana. Survival gains about 1 DPS at 3 minutes and more in longer fights.

lines.title: Fury on Battle Shout duty fills gaps closer to Bloodthirst and Whirlwind and uses Heroic Strike from 60 Rage during Reckless Swings
lines.note: Heroic Strike and Hamstring wait until Bloodthirst and Whirlwind are at least 1 sec away. Worth about 5 DPS.

lines.title: Combat Swords is the Rogue's default build again
lines.note: With Windfury Totem on main hand attacks it is the Rogue's highest build at 3 minutes, ahead of Combat Daggers. No number moves; only the build a Rogue opens on.

lines.title: Tanking: every tank's enchants re-picked slot by slot
lines.note: Each tank preset takes the best Phase 1 enchant for each slot at its own goal: Greater Agility boots for the Warrior and Warden, Strength wrists for the Warrior, an Agility cloak for the Warden, and for the Paladin Agility, Holy Power gloves, spell power wrists and a spell power or Agility neck. The Protection Paladin gains about 95 at Max threat and 85 at Balanced, and moved to 1st at Max survival (1811 against the Warrior's 1776) until the Shieldsworn and Unbridled Wrath hotfixes put the Warrior back on top. No damage preset changes.

lines.title: Tanking: flasks and consumables re-picked for each tank's goal, raid-only consumables left out
lines.note: Flask of the Titans at Max survival for the Warrior, Bear and Warden (and Warden Balanced), Flask of Supreme Power for the Paladin at Max survival, Wizard Oil for the Paladin. The Warrior's Dense Sharpening Stone and the Warden's Greater Mageblood Elixir come out, since a tank can't count on them outside a raid. No damage preset changes.

lines.title: Tanking: the Bear at Max survival is a Tauren with Feral Instinct and leans on Frenzied Regeneration
lines.note: Tauren replaces Night Elf. Frenzied Regeneration and Swipe at 80 Rage, Barkskin from 20 sec in at Max threat. The Bear's Max survival score goes from -297 to 262. No damage preset changes.

lines.title: Tanking: Warden totems re-tuned, and the Warrior keeps Shield Wall for the last 13 sec at Max survival
lines.note: The Warden at Max threat keeps Searing Totem and Fire Nova up all fight on new talents; Balanced and Max survival drop Healing Stream Totem. The Warden scores 2562 at Max threat (was 2,496) and 1224 at Balanced (was 1,125). No damage preset changes.

lines.title: Healing: Restoration Druids cast Nature's Swiftness on its own, and take Heart of the Wild
lines.note: Nature's Swiftness now also makes Wild Growth instant, so the Druid saves it for an instant Regrowth when someone drops under 45% (raid) or an instant Healing Touch when the tank drops under 45% (tank). Subtlety's points go to Heart of the Wild. Raid carry 1.391 to 1.414, tank carry 1.235 to 1.269. No damage preset changes.

lines.title: Healing: the Holy Priest raid healer takes Twilight Focus, the Holy Paladin raid healer leads with Flash of Light
lines.note: The raid Holy Priest moves Inspiration's 3 points to Twilight Focus; the tank healer keeps Inspiration. The raid Holy Paladin drops the top Holy Light ranks and Divine Favor for Flash of Light on the most hurt. Carry: Holy Priest 1.437 to 1.461, Holy Paladin 1.413 to 1.430. No damage preset changes.

lines.title: Healing: the Restoration Shaman raid healer saves Nature's Swiftness for an instant Healing Wave
lines.note: Used when someone in the group drops under 65%. Raid carry 1.395 to 1.412. No damage preset changes.

lines.title: Healing: every healer takes Greater Cleric's Elixir, Phase 1 food and an oil it can buy
lines.note: Greater Cleric's Elixir replaces Greater Arcane Elixir, whose spell damage heals nothing. Food is Wicked Smoothie for the Druid and Runn Tum Tuber Surprise for the rest; oils are Wizard Oil, or Lesser Mana Oil for the raid and Holy tank Paladin. Flask of Supreme Power stays. No damage preset changes.

lines.title: Healers' Most Hurt and Lowest Health checks read the health the healer has seen
lines.note: Current Health checks now read the same delayed health the healer picks its target by, and count a target as full when nobody is left to heal. It moves healer results a little. No damage preset changes.

lines.title: Unsealed Wrath no longer stores copies from Windfury Totem's extra swings
lines.note: From the November 11 hotfixes. A totem swing still spends the copies the paladin's other seals stored, since the post doesn't say otherwise (an assumption on the Assumptions tab). Together with Judgement becoming a ranged attack, this is most of the Retribution twist builds' drop.

lines.title: Extra attacks no longer roll Windfury Totem
lines.note: Windfury's own swings, Hand of Justice, Sword Specialization, Thrash Blade and Reckoning no longer get a Windfury Totem roll of their own, as our combat logs show. Combat Swords loses about 2.6 at 3 minutes; on the Tanking tab the Protection Paladin's scores drop (Balanced 2,838 to 2,809 for the Balanced build), back to 2,837 once Windfury Totem rolled on every main hand hit, Holy Strike included.

lines.title: Retribution rotations re-tuned after the Judgement hotfix: Seal of Righteousness stays up
lines.note: With Judgement a ranged attack, Judgement of Command lost its edge. The twist builds keep Seal of Righteousness up and swap to Seal of Command for the swing that spends its copies, back once Command has stored three. Ret Shock and its Wisdom duty keep Seal of Righteousness up and cast Holy Shock ahead of Holy Strike; the Wisdom duties put Holy Strike first. Sub Holy vs Undead trades a point of Reverence for a third point of Divine Intellect. With the November 11 hotfixes, the twist and sub Holy builds end 18 to 21 lower at 3 minutes, sub Holy vs Undead 11 lower, and Ret Shock 4 to 5 higher.

lines.title: Volley no longer triggers procs

Touch of the Depths and Satyr's Touch take their new damage, and Band of the Damned is in. No preset wears them.

lines.title: Windfury Weapon's extra attacks can trigger Windfury Totem
lines.note: Our combat logs show a Windfury Weapon attack rolling Windfury Totem, so the two can chain; the other extra attacks still don't roll it. With the Flametongue Weapon fix and the Water Shield and Imp GW re-tunes, the Enhancement presets end 22 to 25 higher at 3 minutes.

lines.title: Flametongue Weapon (rank 6) hits 5.5 less
lines.note: Our combat logs show each hit 5.5 lower. No preset uses it: Windfury Weapon stays about 120 to 135 ahead on the Enhancement presets.

lines.title: Enhancement re-tuned after the Windfury change: Water Shield casts Flame Shock before Stormstrike, Imp GW wears less hit
lines.note: The Water Shield build puts Flame Shock ahead of Stormstrike again (0.4 to 3 higher by fight length). Imp GW trades 1% of gear hit for other stats (1 to 3 higher), and its Dwarf trades 2%.

lines.title: Item fixes: Frightskull Shaft procs 3.9 times a minute, Weakening Disease ticks for 15 over 14 sec
lines.note: No preset wears them.

lines.title: A missed, dodged or parried Ferocious Bite gives back 80% of its Energy
lines.note: It keeps its combo points and the extra Energy, so an avoided Bite costs 7 Energy instead of 35, as a combat log shows. Sharpened Claws now raises spell crit too in the feral forms, which no preset feels. Feral rises about 2.5 at 3 minutes.

lines.title: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization raises only the Holy hits that strike as melee, and Consecration
lines.note: Combat logs show its Holy part on the seals, Holy Strike, Judgement of Command and Consecration, but not on Judgement of Righteousness since Judgement became a ranged attack, nor on Exorcism or Hammer of Wrath. Retribution falls 6 to 17, most on the Holy Shock and vs Undead presets.

lines.title: Judgement of Command strikes as a melee attack again
lines.note: The game's data keeps it a melee attack, unlike Judgement of Righteousness and of Fury, and a combat log since the Judgement change backs that. It rolls on the melee table again and procs what melee hits proc. Retribution rises 2 to 6.

source.label: wago.tools: Judgement of Command's spell categories

lines.title: Windfury Totem rolls on every main hand melee hit, white or special
lines.note: Any landed main hand melee hit can trigger it now, special attacks included: Bloodthirst, Mortal Strike, Whirlwind's main hand strike, Holy Strike, Judgement of Command, Stormstrike, Claw, Raptor Strike. Off-hand strikes, extra attacks and seal procs still don't, and it can trigger at most once every 0.1 sec. With the rotations below, Warriors rise 24 to 70 (two-hand Fury the most), Retribution 36 to 58, Feral about 30, Enhancement about 26, Survival about 20, Subtlety 4.

lines.title: Arms waits out Windfury Totem's 0.1 sec after a swing
lines.note: Mortal Strike, Overpower, Rend, Execute and Hamstring hold until the totem can trigger again after a main hand swing, about 1 DPS. Fury and two-hand Fury lose with the wait and don't take it.

lines.title: Enhancement holds Stormstrike for Windfury Weapon's cooldown
lines.note: All four builds wait to Stormstrike until Windfury Weapon can trigger from it.

lines.title: Feral Ferocious Bites at 65 Energy and times its abilities for Windfury Totem
lines.note: Bite at 65 Energy adds about 2; waiting out the totem's 0.1 sec cooldown adds about 1 more on the default build. The Faerie Fire duty takes the Bite only.

lines.title: Retribution twists on one Unsealed Wrath copy, and Holy Shock keeps Seal of Command up
lines.note: The twist swaps seals once one copy is stored (was 2) with no mana limit, about 4; the Holy Shock builds keep Seal of Command up without twisting, about 29; vs Undead swaps on 2 copies, about 1.

lines.title: Assumptions: Execute's second Windfury Totem roll and Blood Fury's weapon damage, both probably bugs
lines.note: Combat logs show Execute rolling Windfury Totem twice and Orc Blood Fury raising weapon damage by 10%, neither of which the tooltips say. The report keeps Execute to one roll and includes Blood Fury's weapon damage, and shows the other side of each as an alternate: Execute rolling twice adds 13 to 23 DPS, Blood Fury without weapon damage costs 2 to 7.

lines.title: Tanking: the Warrior's Balanced and Max survival rotations re-tuned for Windfury Totem
lines.note: Heroic Strike from 40 Rage, Revenge ahead of Shield Slam, and Thunder Clap refreshed under 8 sec. With the new Windfury Totem rule, which every tank gains from (the Bear the most), the Warrior's Balanced score rises 22 and Max survival 19; Max threat keeps its rotation.

lines.title: Healing: Wild Growth heals twice as much a tick, and its ranks share one cooldown
lines.note: Its tick coefficient is 0.066 of spell healing (was 0.033), from the Forever client's data. The raid Restoration Druid heals for less mana (2.44 effective healing per mana, was 2.19), but its score falls slightly, 1.41 to 1.39, and it drops from 3rd to 4th behind the raid Restoration Shaman.

lines.title: Imp Firebolt ranks 2 to 4 take the Forever client's damage
lines.note: Only the leveling ranks change; the level 60 Imp is unchanged.

lines.title: Item data: Dawn trinkets vs Undead, Diabolic Mantle, Legplates of Vigilance, new items and reveals
lines.note: Seal of the Dawn gives 78 attack power vs Undead (was 81) and Rune of the Dawn 46 spell damage (was 48). Diabolic Mantle gives 5 mana every 5 sec and 17 Fire spell power, Legplates of Vigilance 1% hit. Scales of the Devourer, Silithid Queen's Husk and Onyxia Scale Breastplate are added; Bolt's Charged Eyeball, Everlook Pathcarver and Chained Essence of Eranikus are modeled; more items seen in game are in. No preset wears them.

lines.title: Wildstalker Armor's 5-piece bonus also takes 1 sec off Multi-Shot
lines.note: No preset wears the set.

lines.title: Hunter pets' auto attacks no longer use the hunter's crit
lines.note: A pet's white swings crit only at the pet's own chance; Bite, Claw and its other abilities keep the hunter's crit. With the hunter fixes below, Beast Mastery falls 67 to 75, Marksmanship 30 to 33 and Survival 19 to 23.

lines.title: Hunter melee and traps: Predator's Edge counts twice on Raptor Strike, a queued Raptor Strike keeps the off-hand miss penalty, traps roll spell hit
lines.note: Raptor Strike crits for x2.69 with Predator's Edge 5/5 (was x2.30); Mongoose Bite and Strider Kick take it once. Queuing Raptor Strike no longer lifts the dual-wield hit penalty. Immolation and Explosive Trap use the hunter's spell hit, so they miss less.

lines.title: Beast Mastery weaves a melee swing whenever it fits, not only when Raptor Strike is ready
lines.note: It walks in for every main hand swing the weave fits, with Raptor Strike queued when ready: about 0.4 at 180 sec and 2 at 300 sec.

lines.title: Death Mark always hits, its cap scales with melee crit, and its payout can't crit
lines.note: Subtlety rises about 5.

lines.title: Warrior: Unbridled Wrath procs from melee abilities except Whirlwind, Cleave spends one Reckless Swings charge, and an avoided Execute keeps its extra Rage
lines.note: Unbridled Wrath now procs from Bloodthirst, Mortal Strike, Execute and the other damaging abilities as well as white hits, but not Whirlwind. A Cleave uses one Reckless Swings charge however many targets it hits. An Execute that misses or is dodged or parried keeps its extra Rage. Warriors rise 8 to 10.

lines.title: Seal of Command never rolls Windfury Totem, and Execute rolls it once
lines.note: Blizzard fixed Execute's second Windfury Totem roll, so the report's alternate for it is gone; the Seal of Command alternate is gone too. The report already counted both this way.

lines.title: A Shieldsworn Holy Strike no longer rolls Windfury Totem
lines.note: It strikes with the shield. No damage preset takes Shieldsworn.

lines.title: Healing: Vampiric Embrace heals 10% of the priest's own Shadow damage (the priest 20%)
lines.note: Only the casting priest's Shadow damage counts now.

lines.title: Tanking: the Protection Paladin and Warrior scores after the Shieldsworn and Unbridled Wrath hotfixes
lines.note: With Holy Strike out of Windfury Totem's reach, the Protection Paladin drops at every goal: Balanced 2,837 to 2,809, Max survival 1,834 to 1,780, Max threat 3,273 to 3,249. With Unbridled Wrath now proccing from abilities as well as white hits, the Protection Warrior rises at Balanced, 3,443 to 3,470, and at Max survival, 1,795 to 1,848; Max threat stays near 4,230. The Warrior is back to 1st at Max survival. The Bear and the Warden are unchanged, and so is every healer.

lines.title: Darkmoon Card: Blue Dragon procs on 3% of casts and Heroism heals 158 to 238
Item data: Bad Hat, Forever stats for rings and trinkets, Totem of Tides and Idol of Rejuvenation
lines.note: Bad Hat loses its +23 Shadow damage. Darkspear Signet, Militant's Band, Souvenir Sea Shell, Everstaring Abomination Eye and Onyxia Blood Talisman get their Forever stats; Darkmoon Card: Heroism and Maelstrom are item level 65. Totem of Tides takes 5% off Riptide's mana cost; Idol of Rejuvenation makes Regrowth's direct heal 5% bigger on a target with your Rejuvenation. No damage preset wears them.

lines.title: Item fixes: Manual Crowd Pummeler's haste has a 3 min cooldown, and the Five Thunders set gets its 3, 4 and 6 piece bonuses
lines.note: Manual Crowd Pummeler's haste comes once every 3 min, as its tooltip says, instead of every 30 sec. The Five Thunders pieces count toward one set with its 3, 4 and 6 piece bonuses. No preset wears either, on any tab.

lines.title: Haste now shortens a spell's global cooldown, down to 1 sec. Physical abilities keep 1.5 sec
lines.note: Seen in a combat log: with Warchief's Blessing up, instants came 1.3 sec apart after a spell and Lightning Bolt cast in 1.3 sec, while Stormstrike kept 1.5 sec. Warchief's Blessing also gives 15% cast speed, though no preset has it. Warlocks gain up to 0.6% at 180s, Balance up to 0.6%, Elemental 0.4% and Frost Mage 0.2%. The damage Paladins lose 0.05 to 0.4%. Enhancement moves 0.1% or less.

lines.title: Tanking: the Warden Shaman after the haste rule
lines.note: Its spells now come faster with haste. Balanced 1,283 to 1,288, Max survival -2,221 to -2,193, Max threat 2,646 to 2,621. It stays 4th at every goal. The other tanks are unchanged.

lines.title: Healing: the Shaman, Druid, Priest and raid Paladin healers after the haste rule
lines.note: The tank healing Restoration Shaman rises from 1.26 to 1.28 and moves from 4th to 1st, a hair ahead of the Holy Priest (1.28) and the Discipline Priest (1.27). The tank healing Restoration Druid stays near 1.27 and drops to 4th. Among raid healers the Holy Priest rises from 1.46 to 1.48, while the Holy Paladin, the Restoration Shaman and the Restoration Druid dip by 0.01 or less. The raid order is unchanged. The tank healing Holy Paladin is unchanged.

lines.title: Method: the haste and global cooldown assumption now asks only about the 1 sec floor and other haste
lines.note: A combat log showed the rule with Warchief's Blessing, so the presets use it. What the log did not test is the 1 sec floor and whether every other haste shortens the global cooldown the same way.

lines.title: Cast speed now speeds up the ticks of Hurricane and Volley
lines.note: Hurricane keeps its 10 sec and gains ticks. Volley keeps its 6 waves and ends sooner. No preset casts either.

lines.title: Healing: raid healers react to a hit as soon as they could see it
lines.note: A raid healer with nothing to cast sometimes noticed a new hit up to a few tenths of a second late. The raid Restoration Shaman drops from 1.40 to 1.39, the raid Holy Priest from 1.48 to 1.47, and the raid Restoration Druid and Holy Paladin move by less than 0.01. The raid order is unchanged, and the tank healers are unchanged.

lines.title: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization raises all Holy damage you deal with a two-hander
lines.note: It now also covers Judgement of Righteousness, Exorcism, Hammer of Wrath and Holy Wrath, which the earlier line left out. Retribution gains about 0.5%, Ret Shock 0.9% and vs Undead 1.2%. The two assumptions about which Holy hits it raises are gone.

lines.title: Retribution vs Undead: Holy Strike goes ahead of the seal and twist steps
lines.note: With more Holy damage behind it, Holy Strike on cooldown is worth a little more than the next seal step: +0.2 to +0.6 at every fight length.

lines.title: Shank triggers poisons, weapon enchants and chance on hit effects
lines.note: Every rogue build gains 0.4 to 0.6%.

lines.title: Heroic Strike and Cleave no longer use up a Flurry charge
lines.note: Fury gains about 0.2%, two-hand Fury about 0.1%. Arms takes no Flurry.

lines.title: Haste shortens Flame Shock's global cooldown, as it does every other spell's
lines.note: Elemental gains about 0.1%. Enhancement moves by less than 0.05%.

lines.title: Deep Wounds: an off-hand critical strike sizes the bleed from the off-hand weapon, Death Wish and Enrage no longer raise its ticks, and Thunder Clap critical strikes don't start it
lines.note: Together with the Execute line below, Arms loses about 0.6%, Fury about 0.45% and two-hand Fury about 0.8%.

lines.title: A missed, dodged or parried Execute refunds none of its base Rage cost (was 80%)
lines.note: It still keeps the extra Rage it would have spent.

lines.title: Judgement of Wisdom gives mana only on a melee swing that lands
lines.note: A missed, dodged or parried swing no longer pays. The builds that read it rarely run short of mana, so no result moves by more than 0.05%.

lines.title: Ice Lance gains 11% of spell power (was 42.9%)
lines.note: Combat logs of a level 60 mage measured it. Frost loses about 12% and Frostfire about 5%; Arcane and Fire don't cast Ice Lance.

lines.title: Frost and Frostfire mages re-tuned for the weaker Ice Lance: Frost takes Missile Barrage, Frostfire casts Fire Blast down to 40% mana
lines.note: Frost moves two Arcane Concentration points and Arcane Meditation to Missile Barrage 2 and Incineration 5, and renews Ice Barrier with 2 sec of Frigid Power left (was 6): 834.3 to 838.4 at 180 s. Frostfire moves Burning Soul to Incineration 5 and uses Fire Blast on cooldown above 40% mana (was 80%): 1006.2 to 1008.1, and about 7 more at 300 s. Both still cast Ice Lance on the last Fingers of Frost charge.

lines.title: Windfury Totem's extra swing no longer gives a Maelstrom Weapon stack
lines.note: White swings, Stormstrike and Windfury Weapon still do. Enhancement loses about 0.9%.

lines.title: Wrack: your damage over time effects also tick at the half points of their own timing while you channel, and their last tick is no longer lost
lines.note: Starting or ending the channel moves no tick, and each effect ends on a full tick when it runs out. Affliction gains about 1.2%; Affliction with Shadow Bolt and the other warlocks move by less than 0.05%.

lines.title: Windfury Totem's extra swing no longer procs Bloodthrill or uses up a Flurry charge, and Execute rolls Windfury Totem twice again
lines.note: Execute's cast and its landed damage each roll the totem, as combat logs since the November 20 hotfix show; a critical strike from the totem's swing still gives Flurry. Fury gains about 1.4%, two-hand Fury about 2.5%, Arms 0.5 to 0.9%.

lines.title: Hunter pets keep the attack power they had when summoned
lines.note: Aspect of the Hawk, trinkets and other procs on the hunter no longer raise the pet's attack power during the fight. Survival loses about 0.4%, Beast Mastery 0.3%, Marksmanship 0.15%; Lone Wolf has no pet.

lines.title: Tanking: the Paladin, bear and Warden Shaman after these fixes
lines.note: Each preset moves by a little at its own goal: Protection Paladin Max threat 3,249 to 3,244, Balanced 2,809 to 2,809, Max survival 1,780 to 1,787; bear Max threat 3,121 to 3,132, Balanced 2,145 to 2,130, Max survival 351 to 321; Warden Max threat 2,621 to 2,625, Balanced 1,288 to 1,285, Max survival -2,193 to -2,246. lines.title: Chain Lightning's spell power coefficient is now 0.714, the standard one for its new 2.5 sec cast
lines.note: Chain Lightning still stays out of the single-target rotations, so no shaman number moves.

lines.title: Rogue server hotfix: Shank always hits and no longer procs poisons or weapon effects, Mutilate's flat damage raised to 44 / 63 / 88, Venom's extra poison chance covers only Deadly and Wound Poison, talent tree layout updated
lines.note: Improved Distract is gone and several talents moved column; Quick Getaway now needs Dirty Tricks, so Subtlety's point moves there. The poisons' charges went up too, which moves no number. At 180 s: Combat Swords 963.5 to 958.6, Seal Fate Swords 957.0 to 940.4, Combat Daggers 946.7 to 949.8, Seal Fate Daggers 920.7 to 903.4, Subtlety 881.7 to 881.3, Mutilate 866.1 to 858.3.

lines.title: Presets regeared to the hit that sims best: specs with hit from talents trade the gear hit they no longer need for other stats, dual wielders carry extra hit for their white swings
lines.note: Each step swaps 1% hit rating for other stats at the same item budget, and each preset keeps the step that sims best. Feral cat takes Nature's Reach 2 in place of Natural Shapeshifter and drops 4% hit from its gear (+26 at 180 s); the Retribution builds with Precision drop 3% (+11 to +12); Arcane mage drops 1% (+7); Enhancement drops 3 or 4% with a point or two moved, such as Tidal Focus 3 (+5 to +7); Fire Destruction drops 1% for Suppression 4 and Aftermath 5 (+1). Rogues carry 2 or 3% more hit (+4 to +6) and dual-wield Fury 2% more (+2 to +3).

lines.title: Dwarves trade Artisan's Precision's spare hit through the same gear steps
lines.note: On presets that sit on the hit cap, a Dwarf wears the gear one step lower in hit, real item stats in place of the bonus stats it got before; Seal Fate rogues take a step less of their extra hit. Every other race keeps the preset's hit, so only the Dwarf's gear changes. Worth about 1 to 8 DPS on the presets it applies to.

lines.title: Warrior server hotfix: Spearing Strike deals 75% weapon damage (was 40%) and 150% against Giants and Dragonkin (was 120%), Raging Blows replaced by Improved Whirlwind, Reckless Swings on a 1 sec global cooldown
lines.note: Cleave and Whirlwind lose Raging Blows' 3 Rage discount, and its point is free. Reckless Swings costs 25% of base health, which moves no preset's damage. Slam's 15 sec cooldown, Improved Slam, Flurry, Two-Handed Weapon Specialization, Improved Tactical Mastery and Bloodthrill take the values the development notes gave. The talent tree layout changed, so every warrior talent string changed. At 180 s on the old rotations: Fury 1153.0 to 1127.9, two-hand Fury 1173.3 to 1134.3, Arms 1097.7 to 1075.8, Arms vs Dragonkin 1142.2 to 1133.7.

lines.title: Warriors cast Reckless Swings below the main strikes now that it takes a global cooldown; dual-wield Fury puts the freed point in Improved Bloodrage, two-hand Fury in Booming Voice
lines.note: Two-hand Fury, its duty builds, Arms and Arms with Battle Shout cast it only under 20 Rage. Orc stays the best race on every warrior build. At 180 s, with the hotfix above: Fury 1136.0, two-hand Fury 1151.0, Arms 1088.0, Arms vs Dragonkin 1147.0.

lines.title: Unbridled Wrath procs only on white swings, not on Heroic Strike or Cleave
lines.note: Its proc type is the melee auto attack. A queued Heroic Strike or Cleave takes the swing's place but is a special attack, so it no longer gives Unbridled Wrath's Rage. A little less Rage for every warrior preset.

lines.title: Divine Favor costs its full 4% of base mana; Benediction doesn't lower it
lines.note: Ret Shock casts it. Divine Favor carries no class flags, so Benediction's cost cut can't reach it. A fraction of a DPS.

lines.title: Every preset re-simmed with a separate random stream for each kind of roll
lines.note: Two sims that differ in one setting now share every other roll, so race, racial and assumption comparisons are about three times as precise for the same number of fights. Every number moves by about its error.

lines.title: Race, racial and assumption comparisons sim as many fights as they need for a set precision
lines.note: Each comparison sims a first batch, measures how much it varies against what it is compared with, and tops both sides up to the fights it needs, up to 40,000: 0.35 DPS between two races, about 10% of a racial's or a target type's worth, about 5% of an assumption's effect. Race ties use that precision. The presets' own numbers don't change.

lines.title: New warrior assumption shown: only white swings that land use a Reckless Swings charge
lines.note: The game data says white swings use its 4 charges, but whether a miss, dodge or parry uses one is decided by the server. If it did, dual-wield Fury would lose about 2.6 DPS; the two-handed builds miss too rarely to lose any.

lines.title: Ret twist is the paladin's default build, in place of sub-Holy
lines.note: With its gear trading hit for other stats it is now the paladin's highest build at every fight length.

lines.title: Survival hunter takes Rapid Killing in place of a point of Resourcefulness
lines.note: One more Rapid Fire in a 5 minute fight; no change at 2 and 3 minutes.

lines.title: Feral cats use the Goblin Sapper Charge
lines.note: Goblin Sapper Charge and Goblin Land Mine work in Cat and Bear Form (the game's own item data allows them in a form), so the Feral cat presets now take the sapper.

lines.title: Ferocious Bite gains more from extra Energy
lines.note: Hotfix 113403 raised Ferocious Bite's damage per point of extra Energy on every rank (top rank 2.7 to 3.3).

lines.title: Gear tables name the right enchant when two slots' enchants share an effect
lines.note: A bracer with Superior Stamina showed as Shield - Greater Stamina, and Greater Agility gloves as boots. Labels only; the sims always used the right stats.

title: Launch hotfix: paladin and druid talent reworks

source.label: foreverchanges.pro: a hotfix to the October 30 build

lines.title: Two-handed warriors' critical white hits give twice the swing's Rage (was 77% more)
lines.note: Combat logs show a two-handed white crit at exactly twice the Rage of a normal swing. The sim added the 100% bonus at the one-handed rate. One-handed and off-hand crits were already double.

lines.title: Paladin talents reworked: Unsealed Wrath replaces Twist of Light, Conviction is 2% crit a rank with everything, Holy Power only crits heals
lines.note: Unsealed Wrath stores the active seal on each landed swing (up to 3 copies) and spends them on the first swing under another seal. Seals no longer cost 20% less, and Vindication no longer raises attack power. Every paladin talent string changed.

lines.title: Retribution presets re-picked for the new trees, twisting seals through Unsealed Wrath
lines.note: Twist up 65 (974.5 to 1039.3) and sub-Holy 60 (977.9 to 1038.1), Ret Shock up 14 (960.6 to 974.9); the deep Holy Shock build drops 53 (908.4 to 855.6) and now takes a Dragonfire Potion. Undead stays the best race.

lines.title: Druid talents reworked: Berserk and Improved Shifting Power removed, Shifting Power on an 8 sec cooldown, Genesis and Naturalist 2% a point
lines.note: Predatory Discipline lets Ferocious Bite keep its extra Energy, and Bite has a new rank 1. Every druid talent string changed.

lines.title: Druid presets re-picked for the new trees
lines.note: Feral takes Furor and Blood Frenzy where Berserk was: up 57 (885.6 to 942.5). Balance and Wrath keep their talents in the new layout and gain from Genesis and Naturalist: up 45 (846.6 to 891.1) and 49 (806.5 to 855.7).

lines.title: Moonkin Aura and Leader of the Pack give 3% crit with spells and attacks, and only one of them counts
lines.note: Feral gains 0.2 from its own aura's spell crit; Balance is unchanged.

lines.title: Hunter tree: Pathfinding and Improved Revive Pet moved
lines.note: The Beast Mastery presets' Pathfinding point goes to Improved Aspect of the Monkey. No DPS change.

lines.title: Frost mage values restored: Ice Lance does 4 times damage to Frozen targets (was 3), Frigid Power 15% (was 3%), Ice Barrier 5% while shielded (was 3%), Winter's Chill 20% a stack (was 5%)
lines.note: Frostfire gains 30 on the same talents (1046.3 to 1076.6).

lines.title: Arcane Blast: 12% of Intellect, +100% mana a stack, 18 sec
lines.note: Server hotfix, not in the development notes. On its old talents and rotation Arcane lost 17.

lines.title: Frost and Arcane mage presets re-picked; Fire and Frostfire keep theirs
lines.note: Frost goes 16/4/31, keeps Ice Barrier up all fight and takes Incineration over Arcane Blast, now as High Order: up 37 (907.8 to 944.9). Arcane spends the cheaper stacks' mana on Arcane Wrath on cooldown: up 28 (910.9 to 939.0).

lines.title: The deep Holy Shock paladin build is no longer in the report, with its Judgement duty and vs Undead versions
lines.note: Ret Shock (deep Holy), 31 points in Holy to Light's Vigil, fell 17.7% behind Ret twist with the talent rework (855.6 at 180 s). Ret Shock, Holy Shock with most points in Retribution, stays.

lines.title: Frostfire is the mage's default build, in place of Fire
lines.note: Frostfire does 1076.6 at 180 s against Fire's 1056.4. Fire stays a preset.

lines.title: Marksmanship and Lone Wolf cast Aimed Shot again while mana is above 40%
lines.note: Below 40% mana Multi-Shot takes the shared cooldown, as before. Up 2 to 3 at 180 s (Marksmanship 1063.7 to 1066.4, Lone Wolf 1087.4 to 1090.0), 6 to 8 at 120 s, even at 300 s. Survival and Beast Mastery keep their rotations.

lines.title: Lightning Overload's extra bolts no longer trigger Judgement of Wisdom or Elemental Devastation
lines.note: The extra bolt counts as a proc in the game data, and those effects don't fire from procs, as with Fire Nova. Elemental loses a little mana from Judgement of Wisdom: 768.5 to 768.4 at 180 s, 753.2 to 752.8 with Mana Tide.

lines.title: Two-hand Fury uses Berserker Rage only under 10 Rage and Slams from 60 Rage
lines.note: Was under 30 and from 45. Berserker Rage's global cooldown goes to a Hamstring instead, and with the bigger crit Rage Slam's swing delay is needed less often. About +5 at every length (1078.2 to 1083.9 at 120 s on the base build).

lines.title: Dual-wield Fury drinks its pull Mighty Rage Potion only when a second one fits
lines.note: In a fight under about 135 s the pull potion's 2 min cooldown cost the one with Death Wish and Recklessness. Up 1 to 2 at 120 s, the same at 180 and 300 s.

lines.title: Arms on Sunder duty Slams ahead of Mortal Strike
lines.note: The duty's Sunders take global cooldowns, and a wait costs Slam's 15 s cooldown more than Mortal Strike's 6 s. Up about 2 at every length (968.0 to 970.4 at 180 s).

lines.title: Rogues use their builders whenever they can afford them, without timing them after a swing
lines.note: Forever's extra attacks don't reset the swing timer, so a proc's free swing is the same wherever the builder lands, and waiting only delays it. At 180 s: Combat Swords 777.0 to 782.1, Seal Fate Swords 743.2 to 747.1, Combat Daggers 788.9 to 790.8, Seal Fate Daggers 751.4 to 752.9, Mutilate 742.7 to 743.8, Subtlety 732.1 to 732.9. Every build stays Undead.

lines.title: Combat Daggers stops pooling Energy, drops Vanish into Ambush and Preparation, and refreshes Slice and Dice in its last second
lines.note: Part of its gain above. Seal Fate Daggers keeps the Vanish and the 3 sec refresh, now as its own rotation.

lines.title: Demonology wears a gear set of its own, built for its own stat target
lines.note: It wore the Destruction and Affliction set, which is short of the crit a Demonology warlock gears for. Up 7.2 at 180 s (1045.5 to 1052.7). Orc stays its best race.

lines.title: Casters stand at the longest range all of their spells reach
lines.note: Distance sets how long every bolt flies. Frostfire and Arcane stand at 20 yd for Fire Blast, Shadow at 22 for Mind Flay, Fire, Frost, Smite and the warlocks at 30, Balance at 36 with Nature's Reach; Elemental stays at 20. Most builds move by under 2 DPS at 180 s. Balance Wrath loses about 7, since a Wrath now flies longer than it casts, and Arcane no longer ends on Arcane Explosion.

lines.title: Balance Wrath is a Night Elf
lines.note: At 36 yd haste shortens the cast but not the flight, so the Skyborne races fall behind: Night Elf 853.0 against Windshaper's 848.3 at 180 s. It holds Elune's Light for the trinket, as Balance does. Windshaper stays the best Horde race.

lines.title: Beast Mastery hunters start the fight at 12 yd
lines.note: Just outside Auto Shot's dead zone, where the weave starts anyway. Up 1.5 at 180 s (1045.4 to 1046.9). Marksmanship and Lone Wolf gain nothing from it and stay at 25 yd.

lines.title: Ice Lance and Fire Blast share a cooldown
lines.note: The game files put Ice Lance's 8 sec cooldown in the same category as Fire Blast's, so casting either puts both on cooldown. Frostfire, the one preset that casts both, drops 11.7 at 180 s (1076.0 to 1064.3).

lines.title: Ranged hunters no longer carry the Goblin Sapper Charge
lines.note: It only goes off within 10 yd, which a ranged hunter reaches only mid-weave. Down 0.1 to 0.4 at 180 s. Survival keeps it.

lines.title: Affliction is an Orc
lines.note: Orc 1013.6 against Human's 1012.7 at 180 s. Human stays the best Alliance race.

lines.title: Warlocks time their second Bane of Doom for the 2 minute cooldowns
lines.note: Bane of Doom deals its damage in one tick a minute later, on the stats the warlock has when it lands. Holding the second Doom one second past its cooldown makes that tick land after the trinket and Blood Fury come back. Up 0.6 to 2.2 at 180 s. The curse duty presets already cast it late enough.

title: Melee rotations tuned for extra attacks

lines.title: Retribution paladins twist seals whenever no Echo is waiting, not only in the last 1.5 sec before a swing
lines.note: Since extra attacks stopped resetting the swing timer, the open window puts both seals on more swings. Against Undead bosses the 1.5 sec window still does better and stays; the Holy Shock builds don't twist.

lines.title: Arms and two-hand Fury warriors use Hamstring from 10 Rage (was 30 and 20)
lines.note: More Hamstrings means more Windfury Totem and sword procs, which pay for themselves now that extra attacks keep the swing timer.

lines.title: Frost mage preset is Undead (was High Order)
lines.note: After the talent rework Undead edges out High Order on Frost.

lines.title: Efficiency also lowers Strider Kick's mana cost
Method: the Windfury Totem and extra attack answers now match the numbers (0.1 sec, the swing timer kept), and Eviscerate's 4% attack power a combo point has its own answer
lines.note: Text only: the numbers already used these since the last update.

lines.title: The raid's Sunder Armor builds up from the pull, no longer full at the pull
lines.note: A warrior tank adds a stack every global cooldown and a second warrior casts one on its first, so the boss is at 5 stacks 4.5 sec in. A warrior preset is that second warrior. It costs physical builds up to 4 DPS. Holding cooldowns for the fifth stack was tested and lost DPS, so the rotations still open with them.

lines.title: Goblin Sapper Charge and Goblin Land Mine only hit enemies within 10 yards
lines.note: The sim used them from any range. Ranged hunters still set off the Sapper when they step in to melee weave. Mages, Balance druids, Elemental shamans, warlocks and priests now take no Sapper. It costs them 4 to 9 DPS.

lines.title: Ranged hunters throw the EZ-Thro Dark Bomb instead of laying the Goblin Land Mine
lines.note: From range the mine's blast can't reach the boss, and its 1 sec cast doesn't fit in a melee weave.

lines.title: Warlocks and priests cast from 25 yards, like mages (was 5)
lines.note: That puts them out of the Sapper's reach, and their bolts now take their flight time.

lines.title: Method: the hunters' notes now say Improved Tracking counts against the generic boss, unlike Murder and the other creature-type talents
lines.note: Text only: the numbers already counted it. A hunter can track every raid boss type except Mechanical, and the talent is worth 4 to 5% to the hunters who take it.

lines.title: Hunter pets no longer have Pet Aggression (+8 damage a hit)
lines.note: No pet trainer teaches it in Forever: Beast Training doesn't list it, as in Classic, where pets never learned it. Cobra Reflexes is now about even and stays.

lines.title: Hunter pets' normal swings hit 30% less before attack power
lines.note: The game's creature damage figure already includes the pet's own attack power, and the sim was adding that attack power on top. 152 logged hits of a level 30 Cat fit the new figure.

lines.title: Mage talents reworked: Arcane Focus removed, Critical Mass down to 3 points (6% Fire crit), Incineration up to 5 points (10%)
lines.note: Improved Fireball is now Accelerant and also shortens Arcane Wrath's cast. Missile Barrage, Arcane Resilience, Improved Channeling and Improved Fire Blast moved in the tree, so every mage talent string changed.

lines.title: Elemental Precision is now Precision: 2/4/6% hit with all spells, Arcane included
Ice Lance has an 8 sec cooldown
lines.note: The game files put it on rank 1 only; the presets give every rank the cooldown, as the tooltip does. Assumed until checked in game.

lines.title: Mage presets: talents re-picked for the new trees
lines.note: Fire and Arcane put the freed points in Incineration; Frostfire in Incineration and Master of Elements; Frost in Arcane Concentration, Arcane Meditation and Arcane Wrath.

lines.title: Frost mage: three Arcane Blast stacks and no Evocation
lines.note: With Ice Lance on a cooldown, the mana goes further.

lines.title: Arcane mage: keeps four Arcane Blast stacks at low mana

title: Rotations that hold at any fight length

lines.title: Night Elf warriors: Elune's Light with the other cooldowns, not in Recklessness
Fury: Recklessness waits for the last Death Wish in long fights
Frostfire: no longer runs out of mana in 3 to 4 minute fights
lines.note: Evocation and the cheaper Frostfire Bolt start 75 sec before the end.

lines.title: Fire: Berserking and Blood Fury wait for 5 Fire Vulnerability stacks
Troll warlocks: Berserking waits for the first Shadow Bolt or Incinerate
Gnome warlocks on curse duty: Eureka! saved for the spells it boosts
Elemental: lower-rank Lightning Bolt only when mana won't last the fight
Holy Shock Paladin: Light's Vigil down to 30% mana in every fight
lines.note: In fights over 3.5 minutes it stopped at 60%.

lines.title: Holy Shock Paladin vs Undead: Light's Vigil saves mana when it would run out
Dwarf Smite Priest: no Chastise against Humanoids
lines.note: Its global cooldown deals more as Smite.

lines.title: Troll Shadow Priests: Shadowguard shown as its own racial
lines.note: The raid damage hits set it off, worth 8.7 DPS on Shadow and 8.3 on Shadow + Holy. The race breakdown counted it in the Troll's base stats.

lines.title: Dwarf: Artisan's Precision includes the gear it frees up
lines.note: A Dwarf's gear trades the hit Artisan's Precision makes spare for other stats. The race breakdown now measures base stats on the preset's gear, so Dwarf base stats match a Tauren's and Precision's bar includes the trade: 5.6 DPS on Fury 2H (it showed 13.1). Race totals don't change.

lines.title: Windfury Totem shown up all fight; its proc is Windfury Attack
lines.note: The aura list showed only each proc's 1 second attack power buff, under the totem's name, at about 9% uptime. The totem is now listed at 100%, and the proc's buff as Windfury Attack. No DPS changes.

lines.title: Feral Faerie Fire duty: Faerie Fire in Cat Form is the caster spell
lines.note: Forever has no Faerie Fire (Feral). In Cat Form the druid casts the caster Faerie Fire, free there but on a 1.5 second global cooldown, so keeping it up costs 8.3 DPS at 180 seconds (it was 4.5).

lines.title: New duty presets: Judgement of the Crusader, Judgement of Wisdom, Sunder Armor and Curse of Recklessness
lines.note: Ret paladins that keep Judgement of the Crusader or Judgement of Wisdom up on the boss, warriors that keep 5 Sunder Armor stacks up for a raid with no warrior tank, and warlocks on Curse of Recklessness. They show with Duty on, with what the duty costs.

lines.title: New hunter presets with a wolf or a tallstrider
lines.note: Beast Mastery, Marksmanship and Survival with a wolf (Furious Howl) or a tallstrider (Dust Cloud) in place of the cat. They show with Duty on, with what the pet costs.

lines.title: Extra attacks no longer restart the swing timer
lines.note: Windfury Totem, Hack and Slash, Sword Specialization, Hand of Justice and other extra attacks swing at once, and the next swing comes when it was already due. Assumed until a combat log settles it.

lines.title: Windfury Totem can proc again 0.1 sec after a proc, not 1.5 sec
Eviscerate: 4% of attack power per combo point, up from 3%
lines.note: Taken from in-game tests by the WoWSims Forever team. Assumed until our own test settles it.

lines.title: Sharpening stones only work on edged weapons, and weightstones on blunt ones
Combat Swords and Combat Daggers: Dense Weightstone on the off-hand mace
lines.note: The same +8 damage as the sharpening stone they listed, which can't go on a mace.

title: Hunter hotfix: Trueshot Aura and Aspect of the Hawk

lines.title: Trueshot Aura and Aspect of the Hawk about halved at lower ranks
lines.note: Server hotfix, not in the development notes. Best at 60: Trueshot Aura rank 5 (+50 ranged attack power) and Aspect of the Hawk rank 6 (+55).

lines.title: High Order Frostfire and Arcane: rotations built around Wind Blessed
Troll Elemental: Berserking right after Elemental Mastery
Night Elf Fury: Elune's Light at the pull
Gnome warlocks: Eureka! timed to cover the spells it boosts

title: Blood Fury, Berserking and Touch of the Grave

lines.title: Orc: Blood Fury cooldown 2 min (was 3 min)
Troll: Berserking lasts 15 sec (was 10 sec)
Undead: Touch of the Grave every 15 sec (was 25 sec)
Presets moved to their best race
lines.note: Shadow to Undead; Combat Daggers, Seal Fate Daggers, Combat Swords and Subtlety to Undead; Enhancement to Orc; Demonology and Destruction to Orc; Destruction Fire to Undead.

lines.title: Races get their own rotation where it does better
lines.note: High Order and Windshaper casters, Troll, Orc and Undead Frostfire, Gnome rogues (Eureka!), and Holy Fire Smite for 5 races.

lines.title: Dwarves trade hit over the cap for other stats
lines.note: On 14 presets: hunters, Retribution, Shadow, Elemental, Arms and 2H Fury.

lines.title: Presets moved to their best race
lines.note: Beast Mastery, Marksmanship and Survival to Orc; Lone Wolf and Balance to Night Elf; Balance Wrath to Windshaper; Arcane to Gnome; every Retribution preset to Undead; dagger rogues to Gnome; Mutilate and Seal Fate Swords to Undead; Enhancement to Windshaper; Arms to Undead.

lines.title: Retribution Shock (deep Holy): retuned rotation
lines.note: Consecration and Light's Vigil timing.

lines.title: Retribution Shock vs Undead and Crusader duty: Light's Vigil retimed
Human: Ruthless 1% crit (was 2%), The Human Spirit 10% Spirit (was 5%)
Dwarf: Earth Fury (2% crit damage) replaced by Artisan's Precision (1% hit)
Tauren: Endurance loses its 2% crit damage
Orc: Savage (1% crit) replaced by Command (5% more pet damage)
Skyborne: Wind Blessed 2% haste (was 3%), Read Leyline weaker
lines.note: Read Leyline: 50% more Spirit regen for 15 sec (was 100% for 30 sec).

lines.title: Warlock: Spellstone boosts Shadow only, not Fire
Mage: Arcane Missiles no longer procs Missile Barrage
lines.note: The talent's text no longer lists Arcane Missiles.

lines.title: Mage: Arcane Instability and Arcane Power no longer boost Ignite
lines.note: No preset takes Ignite with them.
